title: Chiyya Chuza’a

paragraphs: In Seder HaDorot, under the entry Rabbi Shimon bar Chiya Chuza’a, it is reported that he is mentioned in several places in the Jerusalem Talmud. Hyman says that in his Jerusalem Talmud, however, the word “Chuza’a” is not found.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s negative observation concerns the additional name “Chuza’a.”

Seder HaDorot, Tanaim and Amoraim 3483:1 has Shimon bar Chiyya Chuza’a, and 1295:1 lists Shimon as Chiyya Chuza’a’s son. The statement that Chuza’a is absent from the Jerusalem Talmud remains Hyman’s negative observation, not a new corpus-wide search result.
